entry.title: Best Buy taps AI platform for supplier insights
entry.summary: The retailer is teaming up with Circana to gain visibility for more effective planning and informed decisions.

entry.title: Amazon enlists customers in fight against NYC delivery worker bill
entry.summary: The e-commerce giant released a call to action for city customers to speak out against the Delivery Protection Act, or face increased order costs of up to $5.

entry.title: Tropical Smoothie powers expansion with strong supplier relationships, data strategy
entry.summary: The smoothie chain aims to go beyond transactional purchasing and account manager connections to drive new products and mitigate risk.

entry.title: FedEx, UPS’ upcoming rate hikes: What shippers should know
entry.summary: The carriers are deploying another 5.9% average price increase, but changes under the surface could squeeze customers' budgets further, experts said.

entry.title: Under Armour continues efforts to trim SKUs, lead times
entry.summary: The brand, which cleared a 25% reduction goal earlier this year, now aims to cut its assortment in half to simplify decisions and invest in its strongest products.

entry.title: Procter & Gamble plans supply chain workforce cuts as automation expands
entry.summary: The CPG company expects to eliminate as much as 30% of its product-supply headcount by 2030.

entry.title: USPS to upgrade 16 sites just before peak season rush
entry.summary: Locations including Los Angeles and Louisville could see impacts to volume flows as the agency works to complete installations and modifications by Thanksgiving.

entry.title: PETA alleges animal abuse in PepsiCo’s supply chain
entry.summary: The group submitted a proposal on behalf of two PepsiCo shareholders that alleges its sugar sourcing practices pose risks to animal welfare.

entry.title: US readies tariffs over manufacturing capacity, production concerns
entry.summary: The proposed levies, ranging from 15% to 35%, target goods from China, the European Union and 12 other partners following a Section 301 probe earlier this year.

entry.title: Molson Coors, Primo Brands use fuel hedging to tackle logistics costs
entry.summary: While fuel hedging can offer predictability, it can also be costly and difficult to execute, experts said.
